run_mfg_mirror_descent: run mirror descent on an MFG game with configurable iterations, learning rate, and game name
create_mfg_game: create an MFG game with a specified name and optional setting using the factory module
compute_nash_conv: compute the nash convex exploitability of a mirror descent policy on an MFG game
log_mfg_metrics: log mirror descent metrics including exploitability and hyperparameters to a directory or stderr
save_mfg_distribution: save the parametric distribution from a mirror descent run to a pickle file
